title: Naming another held claim's source root rewrites the session's work_binding, including mid-turn, unowning the running turn's later checks
outcome: Naming a source root for a different held claim never re-targets an established session binding mid-turn; the running turn keeps the root it began with, and focus alone decides later turns.
acceptance: bind_fresh_engram_source_root_until keeps an established work_binding when naming a different held claim (as BASE did); it sets the binding only when the session has none, or switches it only between turns, with any change stamped and committed.

A regression test: a session bound to claim A opens a turn, names claim B's worktree mid-turn, and a later check in that same turn is still owned and reported under A; the name takes effect only at the session's next turn, which opens on B with the change stamped and committed. A control session bound to A in which no claim is named and focus does not change keeps opening its later turns on A.
